Minimal preset preserves nav, footer, aside

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"preprocessing\":{\"preset\":\"Minimal\"}}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
